d: Chhath Puja 2026 : aapne bihar men chhath mahaparv ke samapan ki ye adbhut tasviren dekhin.... kahin hajaron shraddhalu ek sath ugte sury ko arghy dete najar aae to kahin ghaton par chhathi maiya ke giton se pura mahaul bhaktimay ho gaya.... munger men mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne apne parivar ke sath suryadev ki upasna ki to arriya men chhath ghat par ek khas sandesh deti saji-dhaji nav logon ke aakarshan ka kendr ban gaee.... bihar ke har jile men aastha paranpra aur bhakti ka aisa sangam dekhne ko mila jisne mahaparv ke samapan ko yadgar bana diya....to aaie tasviron ke jarie aapko…
